title: Untitled
altText: Stunning dark fantasy cartoon graffiti mural by Mr Blob, featuring a surreal winged creature riding a rocking horse next to a blue horse head and a glowing neon skull cauldron in a desert.
description: Painted for FIRPOWALL in Turin, this piece stages a dark western fairy tale: a shaggy, green-drooling creature with a floating cowboy hat rides a wooden rocking horse through a cartoon desert of canyons and cacti, flanked by a blue horse head with a neon green mane and a glowing-eyed skull cauldron. Dark-fantasy character design meets the saturated gradients and glow-effects typical of the artist's freehand spray work.
